attribution: FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech, Conneau et al., Google, 2022.
selection: First 20 eligible archive members per language; distinct sentence IDs; duration >= 8s. Not a random or representative population sample.
audio_changes: Exactly the PCM16 WAV bytes used in the baseline, verified by SHA-256 per task; decoded to float32 for faster-whisper. Full duration, no VAD/trimming. Long recordings processed in 30-second windows.
benchmark_subset: All 240 original recordings for ASR; the same 220 non-English recordings for translation to English.
vad: Not used for this GPU benchmark.
parallel_reference_note: reference_translations joins original FLEURS test transcriptions across languages by sentence ID. Selected audio need not contain every sentence in every language; reference text availability is explicit per entry.
text_changes: Whisper output and original references retained, with identical ASR and translation scoring normalization to the saved Seamless baseline.
